title: PATCH /api/projects/:id/progress — manual progress override
description: Allow users to manually set a progress override percentage. Logs a progress_change timeline event.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH requires auth and project ownership

steps.details: progressSchema = z.object({ progressManual: z.number().int().min(0).max(100).nullable() }). getOwnedProject. Update project.progress_manual = progressManual. Log timeline event 'progress_change' with { isManual: true, to: progressManual }. Return 200.
Set progressManual to 75. Verify DB updated. Clear it (null) — verify cleared. Pass 150 — expect 400.
